annotations.title: Fetch a page, or up to 10 in one call, each with a verdict, injection flags and a signed receipt

description: Returns a web page as clean text, with title, hashes and a signed receipt. US$0.002 per URL; POST up to 10 URLs. Costs US$0.002 per call in USDC via x402 (Base), charged when the call answers below 400 (a no-match or not-found result is charged too); a bad request is refused unpaid. Pay by putting an x402 payment payload in _meta["x402/payment"]. Without one it returns the payment requirements. Docs: https://vehcdj664efetfrsolne5umanq.srv.us/docs/fetch

return_text.description: Also return up to 20,000 characters of clean text (per page). Default false.

url.description: http(s) URL to fetch (max 2,048 characters). Send url or urls, not both.

urls.description: Instead of url: 1 to 10 distinct http(s) URLs in one call, priced per URL (the route price × the count). The answer is results[], one per URL, each with its own receipt.

name: attestpage_fetch

page.description: Page verdict and evidence, including server_ip, tls and headers (the network evidence also signed into the receipt; null on an edge server); on a PDF also pdf { page_count, pages_read, truncated }.

results.description: With urls only (then page, text and receipt are inside each entry): one entry per URL in order, { url, page, text, text_chars, text_truncated, injection_flags, advice, receipt }; each receipt signs result.batch { index, count }.
